{WITCH_WhoKnows}
if IsCharacterObserving(claudius) && believes(claudius,demon):
    call "LookAll_Claudius"
    call "ClaudiusWitchAccuse"
elif IsCharacterObserving(laertes) && believes(laertes,demon):
    call "LookAll_Laertes"
    call "LaertesWitchAccuse"
elif IsCharacterObserving(marcellus) && believes(marcellus,demon):
    call "LookAll_Marcellus"
    [noblock LookAtWithBody(marcellus,ophelia)]
    [noblock Play(marcellus,am_rub_brow)]
    marcellus: [sad] {Sigh_Intense} "It pains me t' say it, but I saw someone. Lady Ophelia."
    call "LookAll_Ophelia"
    marcellus: [surprise] "She killed 'em without even touching 'em. S-she's--there's something wrong wiv' 'er."
    [noblock Play(marcellus,am_neutral)]
    [noblock Play(marcellus,am_shake_head)]
    marcellus: [sad] "She's not human. S-she's some kind of... demon!"
    [Play(marcellus,am_point)]
    marcellus: [sad] {Come_On_Then_Angry} "S-so, I'm orderin' her immediate execution, fer lack of any other reasonable option."
    [noblock FadeTo(black, 1.5)]
    call "CloseIn_Ophelia"
    marcellus: [sad] "It's the only thing'll ensure all of th'rest of us survive this 'orrible day."
    marcellus: [sad] "Guards, to me!"
    ForceGameOver("Uncovered for my acts.")
elif IsCharacterObserving(brit) && believes(brit,demon):
    call "LookAll_Brit"
    call "BritWitchAccuse"
elif IsCharacterObserving(irma) && believes(irma,demon) && hasSeen(gertrude,NotNeeded):
    [LookAtWithBody(irma,ophelia)]
    call "LookAll_Irma"
    call "IrmaWitchAccuse"
elif IsCharacterObserving(horatio) && believes(horatio,demon):
    if hasSeen(hamlet,NotNeeded):
        call "LookAll_Horatio"
        call "HoratioWitchAccuse"
    else:
        [LookAt(horatio,ophelia)]
        horatio: [afraid] {Ophelia_Scared} "Ophelia..."
        horatio: [afraid] "..."
    endif
elif IsCharacterObserving(hamlet) && believes(hamlet,demon):
    [LookAt(hamlet,ophelia)]
    [noblock Play(hamlet,am_rub_brow)]
    hamlet: [afraid] {Stammer_I} "I saw..."
    [LookAt(ophelia,hamlet)]
    hamlet: [afraid] {Gasp} "A-ah..."
    [noblock Play(hamlet,am_neutral)]
    hamlet: [sad] "Never mind."
elif IsCharacterObserving(polonius) && believes(polonius,demon):
    [LookAt(polonius,ophelia)]
    polonius: [afraid] {Ophela_Sad} "Ophelia--"
    [LookAt(polonius,ophelia)]
    ophelia: [smile] {Yes_Unsure} "Yes, Father?"
    polonius: [afraid] {Sigh} "N... nothing."
elif IsCharacterObserving(irma) && believes(irma,demon):
    [LookAt(irma,ophelia)]
    irma: [despair] "..."
    irma: [disgust] {Ophela_Scold} "Ophelia."
elif IsCharacterObserving(gertrude) && believes(gertrude, demon):
    [LookAt(gertrude,ophelia)]
    gertrude: [sad] {Ophelia_Sad} "Ophelia--"
    [LookAt(gertrude,ophelia)]
    ophelia: {Yes_Unsure} "Yes, Your Highness?"
    gertrude: [sad] {Gasp} "Nothing."
elif IsCharacterObserving(rosencrantz) && believes(rosencrantz,demon):
    [LookAt(rosencrantz,ophelia)]
    rosencrantz: [sad] {Ophelia_Sad} "Ophelia..."
    rosencrantz: [sad] "..."
elif IsCharacterObserving(guildenstern) && believes(guildenstern,demon):
    [LookAt(rosencrantz,ophelia)]
    guildenstern: [sad] {Ophelia_Sad} "Ophelia..."
    guildenstern: [sad] "..."
endif

conclusions: 雷欧提斯口令场景直接设置demontripped。
首次大厅集会的条件只检查demontripped，未检查目击者、尸体位置或NPC发现尸体。
集会场景直接播放号角并叙述发现尸体，随后才按人物是否知情决定揭发分支。
同处存活人物的知情由notneeded_react另行设置，独处不能避免全局集会，但可避免该次能力使用的目击知情。
limits: 无法仅凭玩家口述确认是否还有隐藏的同房间人物；若已出现当众指认或强制失败，需另外核对知情分支。
口令计数阈值5/8也有后续强制集会；记录真实条件，不把原逻辑核查称完整剧情E2E。
